Potatoes are perfect for camping—they don't take up space in the cooler, and cooked in foil they are easy to prepare.    

==Ingredients==
* 1 large baking [[cookbook:potato|potato]] 
* Cooking [[cookbook:oil|oil]] 
* [[cookbook:salt|Salt]]
* [[cookbook:butter|Butter]] or [[cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]] (optional)

==Procedure==

=== Cleaning and Preparation ===
You must prepare your potatoes before using a method below, or the potatoes may cook incorrectly or explode itself.

# Scrub potato on all sides to clean the surface.
# Pierce skin of potato with a fork or small-tipped object to create holes for inside pressure.

===Camping variation=== 
#Clean and prepare potatoes as above.
#Cook over medium-hot coals for 45 minutes or until soft.
#Serve with salt and butter or sour cream.

===Microwave variation===
# Clean and prepare potatoes as above, but wrap them in plastic wrap, not foil. Be sure to poke the potato with a fork to make sure it is cooked evenly and does not explode in the microwave due to pressure.
# Place a piece of paper towel in the [[Cookbook:Microwave|microwave]], and microwave potatoes on high for 8 minutes. Potatoes will be extremely hot when finished. 
# Cut potato into four and serve with toppings of your choice.

===Oven variation===
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 190°C (375°F).
# Clean and prepare potatoes as above.
# Place the potatoes in the oven.
# Cook for 1 hour.
# Remove when cooked. Puncture potato and separate skin from flesh.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Other possible toppings include spicy [[cookbook:beans|beans]], [[cookbook:avocado|avocado]], [[cookbook:salsa|salsa]], [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]] bits, [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]] grated [[cookbook:cheese|cheese]]... or whatever is left in the fridge!

== Warnings ==
* When cooking is initially completed, handle the hot potato with care.
